Control an industrial building's HVAC, thermal storage, batch scheduling and load shedding over 24 simulated hours under price, fault and grid stress.

A 9-component weighted per-step reward covering cost, temperature, grid response, deadlines, efficiency, carbon, instructions and fault mitigation.

How to run it

1. From the cardcopied from the publisher's own instructions

python scripts/train_unsloth.py --steps 500 --output-csv results/training_log.csv

2. Run the Space locallyevery Space is a Docker image or app you can clone

git clone https://huggingface.co/spaces/Prajwal782007/Gridmind
cd Gridmind

The Space also runs live on the Hub; open it to see the API it serves.

Framework documentation: OpenEnv. Needs: GPU for training.
